CrispASR native runtime (Phonon-2 speech recognition)
=====================================================

Talkies for Windows bundles the CPU build of CrispASR to run the optional
Phonon-2 English speech-recognition model on this device.

Component:  CrispASR 0.8.43 (libcrispasr-windows-x86_64.tar.gz)
Source:     https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispASR
Revision:   tag v0.8.43, commit eb633d908120cc5f44b8af8cd4aeb1191f16bfd8
Files:      crispasr\crispasr.dll, crispasr\ggml.dll, crispasr\ggml-base.dll,
            crispasr\ggml-cpu.dll
License:    MIT. The upstream license is included as licenses\CrispASR\LICENSE.
            CrispASR's own third-party notices (ggml, llamafile/sgemm and
            others compiled into the runtime) are included unmodified as
            licenses\CrispASR\THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.

The release archive and each shipped file are verified against pinned
SHA-256 values when Talkies is built.

Phonon-2 model weights are NOT bundled. If you choose to download them, the
app fetches phonon2-q8_0.gguf from https://huggingface.co/cstr/phonon2-GGUF
(revision 3ed3e6ad6e7ce63affffeede37328ff756efaa2f), verifies its SHA-256, and
stores it with the upstream LICENSE and NOTICE files under
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Talkies\Models\Phonon-2-<revision>. Phonon-2 by Fermion
Research is derived from NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 and its weights are
licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
